ind.start: up to ≈ ${{v}}/ha at the season start
ind.water_irr: Irrigation ≈ {{v}} per hectare a year. Crops get {{p}} % of the water they need.
ind.water_rain: Rain covers {{p}} % of what the crops need. The rest is lost yield in dry years.
ind.money_text: Revenue minus seed, fertiliser, field work and water — in an ordinary year. Work ≈ {{h}} a year. Prices are world 2024 prices; enter your own on the summary screen.
ind.soil_text: Organic matter {{dir}} ({{pct}} % over the plan), soil loss ≈ {{e}} t/ha a year, bare ≈ {{b}} days a year.
ind.risk_text: Share of harvests below half of normal. In {{good}} of {{n}} similar years the harvest is good, in {{fail}} it fails.

rules.over_budget: Needs ${{v}}/ha at the start — more than your budget
rules.over_labour: Needs {{v}} person-days/ha — more than the hands you have
rules.again: {{family}} again: more pests. Needs a break of {{n}} yr
rules.legumes: Legume after legume: hardly any nitrogen gained
rules.cover_family: Cover crop of the same family ({{family}}) — pests are not interrupted

field.drag: Drag a crop onto a year below
field.soc_up: More organic matter — the soil darkens.
field.soc_down: Less organic matter — the soil turns pale.
field.n_low: Leaves turn pale: not enough nitrogen.
field.bare: Bare soil — rain can wash it away and wind can blow it off.
field.residue: After harvest the residues cover the soil.
field.eroded: Downpours have already washed away about {{n}} t of soil per hectare — gullies are visible.
field.no_erosion: Hardly any soil is washed away.

story.intro: This is {{farmer}}'s field. {{story}} See what happened to the soil.
story.watch: The soil turns pale: less and less organic matter. Every year more pests — cotton has nothing to rotate with.
story.try: Try adding chickpea in the second year: drag the «Chickpea» card onto «Year 2 — summer».
story.saved: You just saved {{n}} % of water. Now build your own plan.
story.look: Look at the indicators and the arrows between years. Now build your own plan.
